extracted.name: Honey Steelhead Trout
extracted.description: Steelhead trout fillets take on a sweet and smoky flavor thanks to an easy honey and mesquite seasoning mixture that's brushed over top before baking.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.

Place trout, skin-side down, onto the prepared baking sheet. Cover trout with honey, then sprinkle mesquite seasoning, black pepper, and seasoned salt over top. Use a fork to press honey and seasonings into trout.
Bake in the preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.
